description: This file is a shell script designed to perform functional API tests, execute memory checks using valgrind on a service binary, manage supervisor services, and generate memory coverage reports.

methods.name: run_valgrind
methods.description: Runs the bbfdmd service under valgrind with full leak check and origin tracking.

methods.name: run_valgrind_verbose
methods.description: Runs bbfdmd under valgrind with verbose output.

methods.name: run_valgrind_redirect
methods.description: Runs bbfdmd under valgrind, redirects output to a report file, and appends output to a log file.
